questions.q: How far ahead do couples book?
questions.a: Most book twelve to eighteen months ahead, summer Saturdays first. Check your date above; it takes a minute.

questions.q: How do we hold our date?
questions.a: A third of the price holds it, by the payment link we send with the contract.

questions.q: Will you be in the way?
questions.a: We work quietly, with small cameras and no lights during the ceremony. Most guests forget we're there.

questions.q: Do you record the vows and the speeches?
questions.a: Yes, with small microphones we fit before the ceremony and on the speakers' table.
Where the venue and the airspace allow it, and only in dry, calm weather, so we never promise it.

questions.q: Do we need to feed you?
questions.a: A hot meal for each of us when your guests eat, please. We'll eat out of sight and be back before the speeches.

questions.q: When do we get our film?
questions.a: Three photographs and a few seconds of film the next morning, then the rest as the timeline shows.
We choose licensed music that fits your day, and ask you first if you have a song in mind.
Only if you say yes. Your film is yours; we ask before showing any of it.
Anywhere. Travel within mainland Britain is in the price; abroad, we quote flights and a night's stay.

questions.q: Can we see how our film is coming along?
questions.a: Yes. We send you a code; your page shows where your film is (footage in, the edit, colour, sound, delivered) and when your trailer is due.

questions.q: Can you fly the drone at our venue?
questions.a: Only where the venue agrees and the airspace allows it. Our venues page lists the rule at each venue we know.
